content.body: - THE SYSTEM SHALL reject exports larger than 50,000 rows with a 413 Payload Too Large response.

rationale: First draft — picked a conservative ceiling.

content.body: - WHEN an export exceeds 1,000,000 rows, THE SYSTEM SHALL return a 202 Accepted with a job handle and deliver the file asynchronously to the requesting user's downloads tab.

rationale: Re-draft after talking to the analytics team — synchronous ceiling was too low; async fallback at a higher threshold is what enterprise actually needs. Per Decision 2 this replaces the previous proposal on the same anchor/agent.
